clips.title: The story
paras: In Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike needs a runner for business beyond the valley. Mountaineer Kadrell sends travelers to the northern watchtower, where Stormpike waits with an assignment that leads into neighboring lands.

Mountaineer Stormpike watches from the northern guard tower, but his post keeps him from leaving Loch Modan. Mountaineer Kadrell points capable travelers toward guards who cannot leave their duties. With troggs and roaming wildlife threatening the roads and outposts, the Mountaineers have little room to spare. Stormpike needs a messenger for urgent personal business far beyond the region's borders.

You find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower, above the valley. A member of the prominent Stormpike clan, he has affairs beyond the frontier defense of Thelsamar. Carrying his message and supplies means crossing regional borders on his behalf, taking you from the loch onto the highways of Khaz Modan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner. Someone to do a little traveling for him. How about it? Are you the dwarf for the job?
If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's right. I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding. In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.
